title: Undas expressway surge to hit over 750,000 a day

blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS—Expressway managers advised motorists to plan their Undas travel as they project vehicles to reach more than 750,000 each day across major superhighways bound for different destinations in Northern, Central, and Southern Luzon. The Metro Pacific Tollways Corporation (MPTC) projects an average vehicular increase of 12 percent during the peak travel days of October 30 and 31, compared to the minimal 3-5 percent increase in overall traffic volume at all its superhighways – the North Luzon Expressway (NLEX), Subic Clark Tarlac Expressway (SCTEX), NLEX Connector, the Cavite Expressway (CAVITEX), and the Cavite Laguna Expressway (CALAX).
